title: No Time to Die
description: James Bond has left active service. His peace is short-lived when Felix Leiter, an old friend from the CIA, turns up asking for help, leading Bond onto the trail of a mysterious villain armed with dangerous new technology.

title: Želary
description: A nurse is part of the resistance in 1940s Czech Republic. She is discovered and must find a place to hide. A patient whose life she saved, from a remote mountain village where time stopped 150 years ago, agrees to hide her as his wife.

title: Blue Is the Warmest Colour
studio: Wild Bunch / Quat'sous Films / Alcatraz Films
description: Adèle's life is changed when she meets Emma, a young woman with blue hair, who will allow her to discover desire and to assert herself as a woman and as an adult. In front of others, Adèle grows, seeks herself, loses herself, and ultimately finds herself through love and loss.

title: Little Trouble Girls
description: 16-year-old Lucia joins Catholic school choir, befriends senior Ana-Maria. During choir retreat at convent, Lucia's attraction to a restoration worker creates tension with Ana-Maria and challenges her faith.

title: DJ Ahmet
description: A 15-year-old Yuruk boy from a remote Macedonian village escapes into music amidst parental expectations, societal conservatism, and forbidden love for a promised girl.

title: Pride & Prejudice
description: When Elizabeth Bennet meets the handsome Mr. Darcy, she believes he is the last man she could ever marry, but as their lives become intertwined, she finds herself captivated by the man she has sworn to hate forever.

title: Falcon Lake
description: A shy teenager on a summer vacation experiences the joy and pain of young adulthood when he forges an unlikely bond with an older girl.

title: Little Women
description: In 19th century Massachusetts, the March sisters--Meg, Jo, Beth, and Amy--on the threshold of womanhood, go through many ups and downs in life and endeavor to make important decisions about their futures.

title: Barbie
studio: Warner Bros. Pictures / Heyday Films / LuckyChap Entertainment
description: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the outside world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among regular humans.

title: Dinosaur Hotel
description: Sienna is desperate to win a large cash prize in a secret underground game show, but dinosaurs begin to hunt her down for the entertainment of the rich and wealthy. Can she be the last to survive the horrific night to win the prize?

title: Dinosaur Hotel 3
description: A group of people with dodgy backgrounds wake up in a hotel infested with Dinosaurs and soon discover they must play the games to survive the night.

title: Snake Hotel
description: A group of inmates make a gamble to shorten their prison sentences by taking part in a game of cat and mouse with a giant mutated snake.

title: Firenado
description: An accountant for the mob has to escape a whirlwind of fire while being chased by armed robbers

title: Raw
studio: Petit Film / Rouge International / Wild Bunch
description: A young vegetarian undergoing a carnivore hazing ritual at veterinary school develops an overwhelming taste for meat that escalates dangerously.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
description: On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is commissioned to paint a wedding portrait of a reluctant young bride.

title: Anatomy of a Fall
studio: Les Films Pelléas / Les Films de Pierre
description: A woman is suspected of murder after her husband's death in the snow, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the main witness during an intense trial.

title: Martyrs
description: A young woman's quest for revenge against the people who kidnapped and tormented her as a child leads her and a friend into a terrifying journey into depravity.

title: Titane
description: Following a series of unexplained crimes, a father is reunited with the son who has been missing for 10 years while a bizarre series of murders continues.

title: Climax
description: French dancers gather in an empty school building to rehearse on a wintry night. The all-night celebration quickly morphs into a hallucinatory nightmare when they discover their sangria has been spiked with LSD.

title: The Cremator
description: In 1930s Prague, an eccentric cremator obsessed with liberating human souls gradually falls under the influence of Nazi ideology, descending into madness and macabre crimes.

title: I Served the King of England
genres: comedy drama romance period piece war
description: An ambitious young busboy in pre-war Prague schemes his way through luxury hotels and wartime chaos to become a millionaire.

title: Kolya
description: A confirmed bachelor and cellist in Soviet-occupied Czechoslovakia enters a fake marriage for cash, but is unexpectedly left to care for a five-year-old Russian boy.

title: Class Enemy
description: The arrival of a strict German substitute teacher and the sudden suicide of a student spark a fierce and destructive rebellion among high school classmates.

title: Consequences
description: After being sent to a youth detention center, an 18-year-old rebel is drawn into the violent and criminal world of an alluring gang leader.

title: Rooster's Breakfast
description: An auto mechanic apprentice in a sleepy Slovenian town falls into forbidden love with a local gangster's wife while dreaming of famous adult film stars.

title: Baskin
description: A squad of unsuspecting cops answers a midnight backup call and stumbles straight into a trap door leading to a gruesome, surreal hellscape.

title: Siccin
description: A woman consumed by jealousy uses black magic to cast a lethal curse on her cousin's wife, unleashing demonic consequences on the entire family.

title: Once Upon a Time in Anatolia
description: A group of men including a police commissioner, a prosecutor, a doctor, and a murder suspect search the Anatolian steppes for a buried body throughout a long night.

title: Winter Sleep
description: A retired actor who runs a mountaintop hotel in central Anatolia deals with conflicts with his young wife and his sister as snow isolates the area.

title: Mustang
description: In a remote Turkish village, five orphaned sisters' innocent interaction with boys triggers an extreme conservative backlash that turns their home into a prison.

title: Godzilla
description: The world is beset by the appearance of monstrous creatures, but one of them may be the only thing capable of saving humanity.

title: Kong: Skull Island
description: After the Vietnam War, a team of scientists and soldiers explores an uncharted island in the Pacific, venturing into the domain of the mighty Kong and subterranean terrors.

title: Cloverfield
description: A group of friends venture deep into the streets of New York on a rescue mission during a rampaging attack by a gigantic monster of unknown origin.

title: The Mist
description: A freak storm unleashes a species of bloodthirsty creatures on a small town, where a small band of citizens hole up in a supermarket and fight for their lives.

title: Brotherhood of the Wolf
genres: action adventure horror period piece monster
description: In 18th-century France, a knight and his Iroquois companion are sent by the King to investigate a monstrous beast terrorizing the countryside of Gévaudan.

title: The Deep Dark
description: In 1950s northern France, a crew of miners escorting a professor underground are trapped after a cave-in and awaken an ancient, bloodthirsty beast buried in the depths.

title: Under Paris
description: A grieving marine scientist discovers that an enormous mutated shark is nesting in the Seine River just days before an international triathlon championship in Paris.

title: Cold Ground
description: In 1976, two journalists hike up the snowy French-Swiss border to investigate bizarre cattle mutilations and find themselves pursued by predatory humanoid beasts.
